series.title: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita
series.description: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita  follows the virtual girl band Mugendai Mewtype (Yumemita) as five girls with unique, shining talents struggle to transition from isolated, individual performers into a cohesive musical group. The series explores their shared, fated journey that transcends virtual dreams and concrete reality, aiming for a global debut while dealing with the challenges of navigating, and ultimately surviving, both their digital and real-world struggles.

series.title: Draw This, Then Die!
series.description: Ai Yasumi, a first-year high schooler living on the remote island of Izu Ōshima, has one obsession: manga. When she discovers that her long-idolized but reclusive favorite manga creator, Yasuno-sensei, will make a rare appearance at Comitia, Ai doesn't hesitate—she has to meet her hero. But that single decision sets off a chain of encounters that will shatter her assumptions about art, genius, and what it truly means to create.

series.title: Let's go KAIKIGUMI
series.description: A nameless man who is six times more afraid of ghosts than the average person gets swept up with the supernatural. The trouble begins when he crosses paths with Mechako, a fearless girl who runs the Kaiki-gumi, an organization that polices the supernatural. Mechako ropes him into helping her revive the organization. Hilariously strange events and spooky shenanigans abound!

series.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
series.description: The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life.

series.title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World
series.description: The story follows Rin Takanashi, a former caregiver in her thirties who is summoned to another world but immediately exiled. Using her "Motor House" skill, she summons a fully stocked modern camper van to cook and solo-camp her way across the fantasy realm.

series.title: Dodgeball Girl Danko
series.description: Inheriting the fiery spirit of her legendary father, a passionate girl battles modern disinterest to build the strongest dodgeball team of the Reiwa era, facing off against the descendants of her father's old rivals in explosive, over-the-top matches.

series.title: Idaten Jump
series.description: Idaten Jump  follows a young, passionate mountain biker named Sho Yamato who is mysteriously transported to the "X-Zone" alongside his friends and his custom bike, the Flame Kaiser. To return to their home world, the group must win high-stakes "Idaten Battles" against other riders across various treacherous environments.

series.title: Suikoden: The Anime
series.description: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

series.title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis
series.description: For over half a century since their creation, cyborg warriors have protected humanity from various enemies that threaten peace. However, the battle continues...  And now, a group of nine cyborgs known as "Nemesis" has emerged, believing that the 009s alone cannot bring peace to the world. Led by Graviton, a cyborg who can manipulate gravity, what is the ideal they are striving for? Are we witnessing a generational shift!?

series.title: Cat Tales
series.description: "What if cats appeared in those stories...?" When cats are added to famous folktales and fairy tales, a heartwarming and surreal new development unfolds...!? Tabby, orange tabby, calico, white cat, and many other kinds of cats x folktales - guaranteed to soothe all of humanity! An adorable cat comedy begins!

series.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Game The Chronicles
series.description: The stories that lie within the cards come to life...

series.title: Looney Tunes Gokko
series.description: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Lola Bunny, Tweety... so many friends are all here! This Gokko (or "pretend play") series has all your favorite Looney Tunes characters like you've never seen them before!

series.title: Candy Caries
series.description: Ame is a child who loves sweets. Living inside her mouth is a cavity named Caries! Caries calls Ame "Mom," turns teeth into furniture, and even hijacks her body. Ame is always being pushed around by this free-spirited cavity. "I'm not your Mom!" Ame cries. "Yes you are! You gave me a room and feed me sweets," retorts Caries. Enjoy this slapstick comedy about a slightly strange parent-child pair!

series.title: The Lenticulars
series.description: Here's my classmates Uta Aihara, Moripura-kun, and friends, who shared joys and sorrows with me during my trainee days, so please do check it out!! A natural, heart-fluttering youth story... but there are intriguing elements everywhere!

series.title: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
series.description: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

series.title: Dark Machine: the Animation
series.description: "Find Senki," those were the final words of Kairi's grandfather and now his mission. DARK MACHINE, a new and captivating eSport game, transformed Japan's economy. The most powerful player controls it with the title Senki. Now, on the seventh Senki, Kairi plays to finally meet them and ultimately take claim. Will he be able to hold his own, though?

series.title: Romelia War Chronicle
series.description: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

series.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
series.description: Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

series.title: The Vermilion Mask
series.description: The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Pelle, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in an eerie atmosphere, he encounters Sonah, a mysterious young girl. As revelations unfold and inner conflicts arise, a young boy takes his first steps forward! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mask battle fantasy!

series.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
series.description: Mitsutaka Oji is a 40-year-old, handsome office worker that is admired by his colleagues. Of course, he has a secret he is trying to hide from everyone: he loves cute things. But with his nephew going to his apartment, Mitsutaka's secret is now in danger!

series.title: Vertex Force
series.description: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family, however, harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira, on the other hand, has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events begin to occur around the world.

series.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
series.description: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor's son to make a bet with her about their future!

series.title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
series.description: The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections. Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients for a love potion but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day to feed her.

series.title: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
series.description: It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist. Satoru, who works as the apartment manager, ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building. Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward.

series.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
series.description: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

series.title: Tank Chair
series.description: In a dystopian city ruled by violent gangs, a devoted young girl accepts the world's most dangerous assassination contracts to intentionally expose her comatose, wheelchair-bound brother to extreme killing intent—the only catalyst capable of temporarily awakening his unstoppable instincts as a legendary hitman.

series.title: Bride of the Barrier Master
series.description: For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

series.title: Metal Armor Dragonar
series.description: A.D. 2087 - the United Lunar Empire Giganos wages war on the Earth Federation Military to take control of the planet and establish a "rebirth" of the human race. During an invasion of a colony by Giganos' forces, three civilian men stumble upon a trio of top-secret Metal Armor units called "Dragonars" and pilot them to combat the enemy forces.

series.title: Time Paladin Sakura
series.description: Time Paladin Sakura , is a magical girl spinoff of the  Da Capo  series. It features a Sakura Yoshino as a seemingly ordinary third grader with special powers.

series.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
series.description: Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length. However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media. Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

series.title: Are You a Jirai Girl, Chihara-san?
series.description: Spring—the first day of the new school term. After the class changes, it was the first day of the new term. Sitting next to me was the person everyone had rumored to be a troublemaker.  With doll-like skin, flushed eyes, and strangely red lips, and a perpetually melancholic expression, Chihara Mai is a high school girl who exudes the typical "landmine" vibe . Kuroki, a plain-looking boy who has just entered his second year of high school, finds himself sitting next to Chihara, who is rumored to be a dangerous person. However, the Chihara he sees up close seems a little different from the girl the rumors describe...

series.title: The New Adventures of Kimba the White Lion
series.description: Leo is a young ambitious lion cub who takes his father's place as emperor of the jungle when is father is killed by poachers. Even though his father's fate was met by the hands of humans, Leo is one of the few animals in the Jungle that doesn't fear or feel hatred toward humans. He is not alone either, he is guided by friends of his father to help create the best animal kingdom there can be.

series.title: Murciélago
series.description: Koumori Kuroko, a former death-row inmate chosen through extraordinary legal measures to serve as a state-sanctioned executioner. By her side is her watchdog and partner, Tozakura Hinako, whose extraordinary driving skills are second to none. As one heinous crime after another lands on their doorstep, the strongest duo takes on the darkness lurking within society.

series.title: Magical Girl Raising Project Restart
series.description: The hit social network game "The Magical Girl Raising Project" selects one out of every tens of thousands of players to become a real life magical girl. The lucky chosen girls gain magic powers as well as incredibly good fortune, and spend their days blissfully. But one day, an absolute announcement declares that the number of magical girls has risen too high and must be cut down to half. Sixteen young maidens are thrust into a merciless, deadly contest to survive...but how many will come out the other side.

series.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
series.description: Psychic investigators don't normally use their powers to lie, cheat, and get ahead. But super psychic policeman Meguru Chojo does. Relegated to a run-down police station and hated by the entire neighborhood, Chojo gets into all sorts of shenanigans, goofs, and gaffes with his rookie partner, Nao Ippongi. Together, they turn the police force into a farce.

series.title: TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume
series.description: Misaki wants to escape her everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere. And while she doesn't yet know what she will be in the future, Misaki knows for certain that she wants to find something she is passionate about. Soon after arriving on campus to start her college life, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Club. Misaki's heart now beats with excitement for the new world that lies ahead on the railway.

series.title: Welsh & Shedar
series.description: The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

series.title: Combat Mecha Xabungle
series.description: On the planet Zora exist two societies: the Innocent, an advanced culture that lives in domed cities, and the Civilians, who are forced to live in the harsh desert wilderness. As dictated by the Innocent, any Civilian that commits a crime is forgiven if they are not brought to justice within three days.  Civilian Jiron Amos seeks revenge on the villainous outlaw Timp Sharon who murdered his parents, despite the fact the three-day period has long since passed. Hoping to get his revenge by stealing the mecha Xabungle from the merchant Carrying Cargo, Jiron teams up with a group of bandits known as the Sandrats and kidnaps Cargo's daughter Elchi, who ends up being sympathetic to his cause. Jiron's quest for revenge soon grows into a conflict much bigger—one that will eventually see the Civilians rise up against the Innocents' rule.

series.title: Pop Pap Polters
series.description: The remote control seems to have moved, and snacks have mysteriously disappeared? It might actually be the work of a mischievous ghost... This is a slightly whimsical and amusing story about three little ghost brothers, Pop, Pup, and Porta, who live inside the walls of a certain house.

series.title: Umayuru Full Gate!
series.description: Class is in session again as new Uma Musume students enter Tracen Academy.

series.title: Bubblegum Crash
series.description: The saga of the Knight Sabers continues in MegaTokyo, 2034. After taking a brief hiatus, the group of mercenary women in advanced hard suits is forced to reunite. A mysterious cybernetic faction known as the "Illegal Army" has initiated a string of high-tech robberies and murders, stealing advanced artificial intelligence components. The Knight Sabers must put aside their differences to combat the rogue Boomers and stop a virus threat threatening the city.

series.title: Death Stranding: Isolations
series.description: Once, there was an explosion...  Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink a legendary porter set out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved.  Based on the video game born out of the mind of legendary game creator, Hideo Kojima, comes a new animation series headed by Japan's up-and-coming animation studio E&H production. Helmed by E&H's Takayuki Sano, it follows in the footsteps of the original in spirit and ideas and depict the world of Death Stranding through a bold and yet subtle touch and top-class hand-drawn animation.   Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the  someones  are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salva
